messages.subject: Error installing camtrapR on my Mac
messages.subject_clean: Error installing camtrapR on my Mac
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
I am having problem trying to install camtrapR in my Mac. I updated R to version 4.2.3 (Shortstop Beagle) and R studio to the latest version too. Then, when I try to install camtrapR, it says:

> install.packages("camtrapR")
also installing the dependency ‘sf’

trying URL 'https://cran.rstudio.com/bin/macosx/contrib/4.2/sf_1.0-12.tgz'
Content type 'application/x-gzip' length 89675934 bytes (85.5 MB)
=========
downloaded 15.9 MB

Warning in install.packages :
  downloaded length 16664245 != reported length 89675934
Warning in install.packages :
  URL 'https://cran.rstudio.com/bin/macosx/contrib/4.2/sf_1.0-12.tgz': Timeout of 60 seconds was reached
Error in download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) :
  download from 'https://cran.rstudio.com/bin/macosx/contrib/4.2/sf_1.0-12.tgz' failed
Warning in install.packages :
  download of package ‘sf’ failed
trying URL 'https://cran.rstudio.com/bin/macosx/contrib/4.2/camtrapR_2.2.0.tgz'
Content type 'application/x-gzip' length 5524387 bytes (5.3 MB)
==================================================
downloaded 5.3 MB

The downloaded binary packages are in
/var/folders/r7/cwcdq3057px_sb65k91c59rm0000gn/T//Rtmp8yIXXP/downloaded_packages

So, it seems that the download of 'sf' package failed, but camtrapR then appears in the list of packages, and when I run the library, it says:

library(camtrapR)
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘camtrapR’ in loadNamespace(i, c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[i]]):
 there is no package called ‘terra’
>

I tried to install terra package from the CRAN repository but it is failing too:
> install.packages("terra")

messages.body_plain:
Hi Ilaria,
The error message gives you the hint that the download of the package sf failed to complete in 60s (probably due to poor internet connection).
By default, R only allows for 1 minute per download, but you can change that in the global options.
So I suggest you try:

options(timeout = 600)
install.packages("camtrapR")

++

Thank you very much, it helped a lot!
Although I was still having problems installing the package 'terra', but I solved it by installing the development version:

install.packages('terra', repos='https://rspatial.r-universe.dev')

Thanks again!
Ilaria
